items.followUp: Define acceleration due to gravity and state its approximate value near Earth’s surface.

rubric.why: The definition must state that gravity causes a change in velocity over time.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for defining it as the change in velocity per unit time due to gravity.

rubric.why: The approximate value of gravitational acceleration near Earth’s surface is 9.8 m/s².
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving approximately 9.8 m/s² (or 9.81 m/s²).

modelAnswer: Gravitational acceleration is the change in velocity per unit time of a freely falling body due to gravity.
For a freely falling body near Earth’s surface, g = 9.8 m/s², directed downward.
